One product per case line per iPhone model; colours in colors/colorImages using the Apple Store per-part product images (store.storeimages.cdn-apple.com). Per coordinator, still-sold cases and protectors for older supported iPhones (17 Pro/Pro Max, 16 Plus/Pro/Pro Max, 16e, 15/15 Plus/15 Pro Max) are included too; iPhone 14 and earlier are not. No OtterBox, Speck, Pela or Zagg products were listed on the page at research time. A second Herschel Cloud Sling listing (Blue/Pink, HSKQ2ZM/A) exists with a different compatibility list; only the Pink/Black HSFC2ZM/A listing is recorded.
